name: zinterp_context_find_var_entry
description: zInterp_Context::FindVarEntry linear-scans varTable for an exact variable-name match.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja cannot fully lift the VC inline strcmp sbb flag idiom at 0x4c1a7a, but the assembly-visible behavior is an exact strcmp-style name match over zInterp_VarEntry.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c1a40 validates reading varTable at context offset 0x68, varCount at 0x6c, scanning 12-byte entries, comparing entry->name against the requested name, returning the matching entry, and returning null when no match exists.
The native smoke verifies successful lookup, missing lookup, and empty-table behavior.
